name: Rouille Recycle
description: Maître Ferrailleur concevant des machines de guerre improvisées à partir d'épaves transformant les déchets en avantages tactiques.

subject.archetype: Rouille Recycle — Ferrailleurs de la Ceinture Rare class radiation

loadout.armor_outfit: Heavy patchwork armor from salvaged hull plates with visible bolt patterns and rough weld seams, exposed hydraulic assist mechanisms leaking fluid from combat damage, thick reinforced gloves stained with oil grease and burn marks, protective welding mask pushed up on forehead revealing determined face with distinctive faction engravings and glowing energy channel conduits running along seams
loadout.arsenal: Modified industrial welding torch converted into combat flamethrower with extended flame range, multi-function cutting tool integrated into gauntlet for both welding armor and severing limbs, improvised explosive charges rigged from salvaged missile parts creating unpredictable devastating blasts Functional combat equipment showing signs of heavy practical use and field customization

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. Combat stance with weapon or tool raised and ready, eyes locked on approaching threat, body coiled like a spring ready to explode into action
attitude.emotion: Lethal intensity — predator recognizing the perfect strike moment

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Rusted Orange-Brown
palette_names.role: primary_accent — salvaged metal surfaces and explosion fireballs

palette_names.name: Welding Arc Blue
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — cutting sparks and work light

palette_names.name: Oil Black
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — deep shadowed recesses and grease stains

color_and_light.lighting_setup: cobalt steel frame with etched faction symbols running along each border edge, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Low dramatic angle emphasizing dominance, wide enough to show full environmental impact of the ability

scenography.setting: Active scrapyard warfare zone inside hollowed asteroid with massive spacecraft structures collapsing under fire sending debris raining down, molten metal cascading from ruptured tanks creating burning rivers, grinding sparks filling air from improvised weapons clashing against enemy armor, hastily built barricades buckling under assault, low-gravity making every debris float after breaking free
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Tension and lethal potential visible in every tensed muscle — combat readiness radiating from posture and grip on weapon, Active combat zone with explosions and engagements around the character, allies and enemies locked in fierce battle, chaos of war as backdrop, Welding torch flame erupting as flamethrower showering bright orange sparks everywhere, heavy metal plates buckling and flying from explosions creating shrapnel, grinding sparks fountaining from metal-on-metal impact, massive machinery parts falling in dramatic slow motion, hydraulic fluid spraying from ruptured lines creating oil slicks, molten metal dripping creating burning rain
